title: Alerting (rules, runbooks, live failure injection, Alertmanager delivery)
proves: Every rules file passes promtool check and test; every alert has an existing runbook and a failure-modes.json entry; Alertmanager delivers a critical alert with its runbook annotation to a local webhook; on private processes a killed worker, a dead probe, a full Redis, a dead outbox row and a hanging Postgres each fire the expected alert, and the API survives the hang.
doesNotProve: Delivery to real Slack or PagerDuty, production thresholds, disk, certificate, replica-lag or backup failures (no metric), or anything on staging or production.
